jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LANCEDB

AI advances at the speed of its research, and research moves at the speed of its data. LanceDB is the AI-native Multimodal Lakehouse: one system where a researcher curates petabytes of video, audio, and every signal derived from them with a few lines of Python, and the next training run starts as fast as the next idea. Customers like Runway, Midjourney, and Netflix build the future of AI on LanceDB, from frontier and world models to robots and autonomous vehicles.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to build the systems that turn LanceDB's marketing into measurable pipeline. Your job is to own the marketing tech stack, the data flowing through it, and the reporting that tells us what's working and what isn't.



You'll partner closely with our Head of RevOps, who owns the sales side of the CRM and the revenue process. Your domain is everything Marketing touches on the way to a qualified opportunity: lead capture, inbound lead routing, scoring, attribution, campaign and event operations, and the reporting that proves Marketing's impact on revenue.



One of the biggest opportunities in front of you is our open source. LanceDB sees millions of open source downloads per month, but we’re still early in our journey to reliably monetizing the open source funnel. You'll build the open-source qualified lead program that turns product and community signals into real sales outreach at the right now.



This is a 0-to-1 builder's role on a small, fast-moving team. You won't inherit a mature ops function. You'll design it, implement it, and keep it running as our go-to-market motion evolves.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the directly responsible individual (DRI) for our marketing systems, including HubSpot marketing automation, signal and enrichment tools (e.g. Common Room, Clay), advertising platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit), web analytics, and event and webinar tooling. You’ll help audit what we have, decide what we need, and implement (or cut) systems when necessary.

 - Build and run lead management: capture, enrichment, account assignment, routing, lifecycle stages, and scoring, so the right leads reach the right sellers quickly and nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Own event lead flow end to end, including registration, badge scans, enrichment, account assignment, and follow-up routed to the right owner within a clear SLA.

 - Build and run the open-source qualified lead program with Product, Engineering, and Marketing, turning open-source activity and account behavior into a scoring system that triggers outreach at the right moment.

 - Contribute to attribution and marketing reporting. Build the dashboards that show sourced and influenced pipeline by channel, program, and account, including a practical way to measure influence on founder-led and frontier lab deals that Marketing shapes but doesn't source.

 - Keep our data clean. Own marketing data hygiene, field governance (including Deal Source), deduplication, and enrichment in partnership with RevOps.

 - Run campaign operations: forms, landing pages, email programs, list uploads, and registration flows, including for flagship events like our Reverie summit.

 - Support the operating rhythm for Marketing: weekly funnel reporting against goal (MQLs, meetings booked and held, pipeline, and new ARR), budget tracking, and the data to support quarterly planning.

 - Partner with Revenue Marketing on ABM infrastructure, including target account lists, segmentation, intent and engagement signals, and program measurement.

 - Proactively find and ship improvements. Use AI and automation to make the whole team faster, from enrichment and research workflows to reporting.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You thrive in a fast-paced, startup environment and enjoy working with high-caliber teams.

 - 6-8 years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations at B2B technology companies, ideally related to developers or AI.

 - Someone who is AI-pilled. In addition to having a MOPs background, you’re comfortable with a GTM engineering approach and using the latest AI tools like Claude or Codex to build in intelligent automations.

 - Deep, hands-on experience with a CRM (SFDC or HubSpot) with a focus on marketing automation, workflows, lifecycle, reporting, and data modeling. You've built these systems yourself, not just managed an agency or team that did.

 - Experience with the modern GTM data stack, such as enrichment and workflow tools (e.g. Clay), signal platforms (e.g. Common Room), sales engagement (e.g. Apollo), ad platforms, and web analytics.

 - Hands-on experience designing lead routing and account assignment, including assigning event lead flow.

 - A track record of building attribution and pipeline reporting that leadership trusts and uses to make decisions.

 - Experience with PLG, open-source, or product-usage signals feeding a sales-led motion is a strong plus.

 - Proven ability to own work end to end without a team to support you. You have taste and strong pattern-matching for common problems, and you move quickly and with confidence.

 - A foundation-builder's mindset: you're motivated by creating process, systems, and measurement where little exists today, and you know when "good enough and shipped" beats "perfect and pending."

 - You use AI thoughtfully as an operator, iterating on how it can improve and streamline your work and the team's.

 - Excellent communicator who can partner with founders, Sales, RevOps, and Engineering and move fast in a small, high-ownership team.

 - Bonus points for: experience at an AI, database, data infrastructure, or developer tools company, or scripting and API experience (Python, webhooks, reverse ETL).
